sql: SELECT json_build_object('sem_cascade', (SELECT json_agg(c.conrelid::regclass::text) FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.contype = 'f' AND c.confrelid = 'public.companies'::regclass AND c.confdeltype <> 'c'), 'teste_victor', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'name', name)) FROM companies WHERE slug = 'buffet-teste-victor')) AS r
